name: Atlantic Storm (JHU CHS)
description: January 2005 ministerial-level transatlantic tabletop exercise simulating a coordinated bioterrorist smallpox attack affecting the US and Europe simultaneously. Notably involved actual heads of state and senior government officials from the US and Europe as participants, providing unique high-fidelity decision-making data.
reputation: landmark exercise in international biosecurity; unique for actual head-of-state participation
notes: Part of JHU CHS historical exercise series. Unique for involvement of real heads of state as players. Open access materials. International coordination dimension adds complexity.

institutions: Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security
